description: Evaluate supplied kernelCAD code or a file to capture an authored NURBS curve (nurbsCurve/spline3d). Returns degree, distinct knots and multiplicities, poles, weights, rational and uniformWeights flags, hasNonUnitWeights, and parameter range. Defaults to the last captured curve in that script; pass feature_id to choose one. The source may load referenced assets. Reports authored curve data, not exact geometry-derived B-rep edge/face NURBS; surface extraction and blending are not supported. Does not update the active MCP session or write a project.

feature_id.description: Optional curve3d FeatureId; defaults to the last captured NURBS curve.

file.description: Path to a .kcad.ts script file. Hosted server: cannot read files from your machine — pass `code`, or `project:<slug>` for a saved project.

name: inspect_nurbs
title: Inspect NURBS Curve
